headline: Fuzhou reports progress on an employment-focused AI test base and convenes a technical workshop
summary: Fuzhou Municipal SASAC reports that officials were briefed on construction progress and technology applications at the national AI application test base for employment services. A later municipal profile says the city talent group is leading the project and describes a planned compute, employment-data and sector-model stack. At an Oct 22–24 workshop, official and government-hosted reports describe discussion of technical work, standards, evaluation safety and future pilot scenarios. These are reported project activities and plans; the sources do not establish deployed service performance or employment outcomes.
